knowledge:
- key_parameters: normalization.LiP=Normalization method for LiP data in dataSummarizationLiP (default is "equalizeMedians") ;; MBimpute=Logical flag in dataSummarizationLiP to control model-based imputation (default is FALSE) ;; differential_analysis=Logical flag in calculateProteolyticResistance to perform linear mixed effects model-based differential analysis of proteolytic resistance ;; model_type=Specifies which model to plot in StructuralBarcodePlotLiP (e.g., "Adjusted") ;; removeiRT=Logical flag in SpectronauttoMSstatsLiPFormat to filter out iRT peptides (default is TRUE) ;; removeModifications=Logical flag in SpectronauttoMSstatsLiPFormat to filter out modified peptides (default is TRUE) ;; removeNonUniqueProteins=Logical flag in SpectronauttoMSstatsLiPFormat to filter out peptides with multiple protein annotations (default is TRUE)
- alternatives: None mentioned.
- when_to_use: Appropriate when analyzing LiP-MS experiments (with or without matching TrP-MS trypsin-only controls) to identify structural changes, proteolytic resistance, or protein abundance alterations across different conditions.
- pitfalls: Condition nomenclature must be identical in both LiP and TrP datasets ;; BioReplicate column needs a unique nomenclature for case-control experiments (e.g., prefixing with Condition), while technical replicates can have duplicate numbering ;; The column FULL_PEPTIDE in the LiP dataset must contain both the Protein and Peptide information separated by an underscore ;; dataSummarizationLiP is memory-intensive; users with limited memory should remove raw files and clear cache using rm() and gc().

workflows.name: lip_ms_differential_abundance_analysis
workflows.intent: Preprocess, summarize, and model LiP-MS and TrP-MS datasets to identify significantly altered peptides and proteins.
workflows.stages: 1. Convert raw data to MSstatsLiP format using SpectronauttoMSstatsLiPFormat ;; 2. Align condition names ;; 3. Summarize feature intensities using dataSummarizationLiP ;; 4. Generate quality control, profile, and PCA plots ;; 5. Run differential abundance modeling using groupComparisonLiP ;; 6. Visualize results using groupComparisonPlotsLiP and StructuralBarcodePlotLiP
workflows.code:
MSstatsLiP_data <- SpectronauttoMSstatsLiPFormat(LiPRawData, 
                                      "../inst/extdata/ExampleFastaFile.fasta", 
                                      TrPRawData, use_log_file = FALSE, 
                                      append = FALSE)

MSstatsLiP_data[["LiP"]][MSstatsLiP_data[["LiP"]]$Condition == "Control", 
                         "Condition"] = "Ctrl"
MSstatsLiP_data[["TrP"]]$Condition = substr(MSstatsLiP_data[["TrP"]]$Condition, 
  1, nchar(MSstatsLiP_data[["TrP"]]$Condition)-1)

MSstatsLiP_Summarized <- dataSummarizationLiP(MSstatsLiP_data,
                                              MBimpute = FALSE, 
                                              use_log_file = FALSE, 
                                              append = FALSE)

trypticHistogramLiP(MSstatsLiP_Summarized, 
                    "../inst/extdata/ExampleFastaFile.fasta",
                    color_scale = "bright",
                    address = FALSE)

correlationPlotLiP(MSstatsLiP_Summarized, address = FALSE)

dataProcessPlotsLiP(MSstatsLiP_Summarized,
                    type = 'QCPLOT',
                    which.Peptide = "allonly",
                    address = FALSE)

dataProcessPlotsLiP(MSstatsLiP_Summarized,
                    type = 'ProfilePlot',
                    which.Peptide = c("P14164_ILQNDLK"),
                    address = FALSE)

PCAPlotLiP(MSstatsLiP_Summarized,
           bar.plot = FALSE,
           protein.pca = FALSE,
           comparison.pca = TRUE,
           which.comparison = c("Ctrl", "Osmo"),
           address=FALSE)

PCAPlotLiP(MSstatsLiP_Summarized,
           bar.plot = FALSE,
           protein.pca = TRUE,
           comparison.pca = FALSE,
           which.pep = c("P14164_ILQNDLK", "P17891_ALQLINQDDADIIGGRDR"),
           address=FALSE)

MSstatsLiP_model <- groupComparisonLiP(MSstatsLiP_Summarized,
                               fasta = "../inst/extdata/ExampleFastaFile.fasta",
                               use_log_file = FALSE, 
                               append = FALSE)

groupComparisonPlotsLiP(MSstatsLiP_model, 
                        type = "VolcanoPlot", 
                        address = FALSE)

groupComparisonPlotsLiP(MSstatsLiP_model,
                        type = "HEATMAP",
                        numProtein=50,
                        address = FALSE)

StructuralBarcodePlotLiP(MSstatsLiP_model, 
                         "../inst/extdata/ExampleFastaFile.fasta", 
                         model_type = "Adjusted", which.prot = c("P53858"),
                         address = FALSE)

workflows.name: proteolytic_resistance_analysis
workflows.intent: Calculate proteolytic resistance ratios and perform differential analysis of proteolytic resistance patterns across conditions using fully tryptic peptides.
workflows.stages: 1. Convert raw data to MSstatsLiP format using SpectronauttoMSstatsLiPFormat ;; 2. Select only fully tryptic (FT) peptides in both LiP and TrP datasets using calculateTrypticity ;; 3. Align condition and BioReplicate nomenclature ;; 4. Summarize data using dataSummarizationLiP ;; 5. Model differential abundance using groupComparisonLiP ;; 6. Calculate proteolytic resistance ratios and perform differential analysis using calculateProteolyticResistance ;; 7. Plot proteolytic resistance results as barcodes using ResistanceBarcodePlotLiP
workflows.code:
msstats_data <- SpectronauttoMSstatsLiPFormat(raw_lip, fasta_file, raw_prot)

FullyTrP <- msstats_data[["LiP"]] %>% 
  distinct(ProteinName, PeptideSequence) %>% 
  calculateTrypticity(fasta_file) %>% 
  filter(fully_TRI) %>%
  filter(MissedCleavage == FALSE) %>% 
  select(ProteinName, PeptideSequence, StartPos, EndPos)

msstats_data[["LiP"]] <- msstats_data[["LiP"]] %>% 
  select(-ProteinName) %>% inner_join(FullyTrP)

msstats_data[["TrP"]] <- msstats_data[["TrP"]] %>% 
  select(-ProteinName) %>% inner_join(FullyTrP)

msstats_data[["LiP"]] = msstats_data[["LiP"]] %>% 
  mutate(BioReplicate = paste0(Condition,".",BioReplicate))

msstats_data[["TrP"]] = msstats_data[["TrP"]] %>% 
  mutate(BioReplicate = paste0(Condition,".",BioReplicate))

MSstatsLiP_Summarized <- dataSummarizationLiP(msstats_data, normalization.LiP = "equalizeMedians")

MSstatsLiP_model = groupComparisonLiP(MSstatsLiP_Summarized)

Accessibility = calculateProteolyticResistance(MSstatsLiP_Summarized, 
                                               fasta_file, 
                                               differential_analysis = TRUE)

ResistanceBarcodePlotLiP(Accessibility,
                         fasta_file,
                         which.prot = "P16622",
                         which.condition = "F1",
                         address = FALSE)

ResistanceBarcodePlotLiP(Accessibility,
                         fasta_file,
                         which.prot = "P16622",
                         which.condition = "F1",
                         differential_analysis = TRUE,
                         which.comp = "F1 vs F2",
                         address = FALSE)
